trace.question: Who is the top spending customer and how much is the average price per single item purchased by this customer? What currency was being used?
trace.evidence: average price per single item = Total(price) / Total(amount)

attempts.sql:
SELECT t.CustomerID,
       SUM(t.Price) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item,
       c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY t.CustomerID, c.Currency
ORDER BY SUM(t.Price) DESC
LIMIT 1

trace.final_sql:
SELECT t.CustomerID,
       SUM(t.Price) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item,
       c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY t.CustomerID, c.Currency
ORDER BY SUM(t.Price) DESC
LIMIT 1
trace.answer: The top spending customer is customer 19182, with an average price per item of about 24.28, paid in Czech koruna (CZK).
